text:
maria: Heads-up — planning the release announcement for Wed 10:00am PT. Need final changelog link, docs anchors, and explicit canary timing from eng. Also we have the webinar slot Thu 1pm PT that needs the landing page link.
ben: We can freeze API-affecting changes Tue EOD PT. Changelog will be published at https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/2.1 (working link). Expect the final changelog note from me after the last QA pass.
liam: I'll push the docs PR today and add anchors. Tentative anchors: #new-routing, #kv-cache, #quant-profiles. Will post the live URL here once merged.
sara: Marketing copy needs the bench headline text — product approved: "~50% lower per-token cost at 8k seq with smart batching". Ben, can you confirm those numbers are safe to call out?
ben: Confirmed on the canary perf snapshot. Quick snippet: `p95 latency: 120ms -> 85ms`, throughput +30% in our dedicated pool. Will add a small note in the changelog about measurement setup.
maria: We also need staging links to embed in the announcement (preview mode). @ash can staging mirror the prod doc URLs so we can drop them in the CMS?
ash: Staging will mirror prod URLs. I expect the stack deploy to complete Tue ~11:00am PT — I'll post the staging links here when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2025-11-05T16:00:00Z — initial 10% traffic on Dedicated, automatic fallback to Hosted variant if errors > 2%.
ben: Note for messaging: fallback model variant is `vicuna-7b-quant`. Please don't label it simply "open-source model" in the hero copy; call out model family + performance caveat.
maria: Got it — copy updated. Also need hero image + benchmark graph. @ania can you produce SVG + PNG (hero + social) by EOD today?
ania: On it. Deliverables: hero SVG (1200x630), thumbnail PNG (600x315). Any specific callouts or colors?
maria: Use blue #0a6cff, highlight cache improvements, caption: "measurements on Redwood Dedicated (nvlink enabled)". Call out the 8k sequence baseline.
liam: Docs merged: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1 — live now. Anchors are #new-routing, #kv-cache, #quant-profiles. Feel free to link directly to those.
maria: Perfect — I'll schedule the CMS publish for Wed 10:00am PT. Final checklist: changelog link, docs anchors, hero assets, webinar landing link, staging preview. If anything blocks, please reply in the next 2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ben: One more: add a small migration note in the changelog about the db index rehash step — it's required for Dedicated customers upgrading in-place.
nash: I'll run pre-deploy smoke tests Tue 11:30am PT and report back here.
nash: smoke passed :rocket:
maria: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll proceed to schedule and tag legal for the embargo. :thumbsup:
